item.title: Muslim charities expect to raise up to 80% of their income during Ramadan - Islam Channel Urdu
item.description: Islam Channel’s 2020 Charity Survey highlights the impact of the coronavirus pandemic on charity-giving during Ramadan and the impressive response of Muslim charities to the current situation.
